item.title: Writing a definition
item.description:
The design law

A stage is defined by what must be TRUE to reach it, never by who moved what. Ask of every stage: what evidence, on record, would convince a sceptical auditor a year from now? Write that as guards. If the honest answer is “somebody said so”, then make that the fact — a named person’s signature on a named claim — rather than a status somebody sets.
